## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:devx` · `area:devpath`, into `pm:queue`. The nav matches the public path

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T09:07Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** on every blog post the top nav shows no current section. It is cosmetic, on the public docs site, and measured with a control.
- **Direction, as the card says:**
  - The fix stays in `apps/docs`. Match the nav against the public path, or prerender the posts under it.
  - Pin: `Blog` lights on a post and on `/blog`, and `Why` lights on the essay. Check both the server HTML and the page after hydration.
  - ⛔ No fumadocs upgrade is assumed, and no gate is added.
- Triage: lands in `apps/docs` (`domain:devx`); rationale: one app, a measured defect.

Per triage `6121159181`, either match the nav against the public path, or prerender the posts under it. ⛔ No fumadocs upgrade, ⛔ no new gate. (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `S, not mechanical` (the dev measures which of the two routes holds on a production build), `mode:subagent`, `model: default`. `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the path at `111ffff55`: "no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 3 declared glob(s)".

Responsibility: `apps/docs` top nav on blog posts | no existing path lights the declaring nav entry on a post | every visitor to a blog post on the public docs site
Thread-read: 6121159181
Serial constraints cleared: no open pull request touches `apps/docs/lib/` or `apps/docs/app/`. Read 2026-10-12T10:13Z.

## ACCEPT: PR #23028 · `domain:devx` seat 1 · 2026-10-12T10:52Z

`session_012yK1ddAdAqfzwigRHZq3r2` · `os-warren`. Reviewed against GitHub on head `7324c3cb2` (merge base `9432bac07`), dev report `6122785871` on this card.

- **Shape:**
  - Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #22977`.
  - Labels `skip-changeset`, plus the labeler's `documentation` and `size/s`. Assignee `os-warren`.
  - `check-governed-merges --pr 23028`: NOT governed, +70 / −1 in 4 files, all under `apps/docs`.
- **Diff, against triage's direction ("match the nav against the public path"):**
  - `apps/docs/lib/i18n.ts` gains `toPublicPath()`. It drops the hidden default-locale prefix: `hideLocale: 'default-locale'`, `defaultLanguage: 'en'`, so `/en/…` becomes `/…` and `/en` becomes `/`. Any other path, and any config without a hidden locale, is returned unchanged. It is the identity in the browser, so only the prerender changes.
  - `apps/docs/components/root-provider.tsx` composes fumadocs' `FrameworkProvider` with `BaseRootProvider`, the same pieces as `fumadocs-ui/provider/next`, with `usePathname` mapped through `toPublicPath`. `app/[lang]/layout.tsx` imports it in place of the package's provider.
  - No fumadocs upgrade, no new gate, nothing outside `apps/docs`.
- **Measurement accepted as the pin** (`apps/docs` has no test runner, and the card rules out a gate):
  - On production builds, `main` `9432bac07` against the fix `7324c3cb2`, both server HTML and hydrated DOM: posts move from `Blog=false` to `Blog=true`; the essay moves from `Why=false Blog=false` to `Why=true Blog=true`; the `/blog` control stays `Blog=true`; `/` and the docs nav are unchanged.
  - A whole-page diff over 9 pages shows only those flips, plus the docs-page half below. A second `main` run was byte-identical.
- **Deviation accepted:** the same seam fixes the docs pages' prerender mismatch.
  - The server-HTML sidebar current-page mark and the prev/next footer now appear.
  - React minified error 418 goes from 1 per docs page to 0.
  - The hydrated docs DOM is unchanged. It is inside the claimed `apps/docs/**` surface and adds no code.
- **Acceptance notes:** `toPublicPath()` and `proxy.ts`'s `/en` redirect are two spellings of one mapping. Recorded in the PR, not filed.
- **CI:** at this comment, `Build Docs`, `Lint & Repo Gates` and two Type Check lanes are still running; the rest are skips on the expected roster. It lands through the queue once every check on the head is green.

  - On docs pages, the current-page mark and the prev/next footer are in the server HTML, and the React hydration error 418 is gone.
